properties.name: shelf_shoaling
properties.why: 100 m across the shoaling band, ring-wide (v1.5 rule).

properties.name: inland_floodplain
properties.why: 100 m on land 0..6 m: the Sandy HWM ceiling on v3 is 5.79 m (185 marks). v1.5 used 9 m; on 15,000 km2 of coastal plain the top 3 m buy nothing but cells. 2026-08-25: zmax 6 -> 5 m (lever L1, user); the HWM ceiling is 5.79 m so the top marks sit on 200 m faces - restore to 6 if they score badly.

properties.name: low_water
properties.why: 50 m over every back-bay, estuary and tidal marsh the domain exists to COMPUTE, and the land below 3 m that flooded. v1.5's bay_water, ring-wide. THE cell-count driver. 2026-08-25: zmax 3 -> 2 m (lever L2, user) to cut the 3.31 M-face probe; restore to 3 if the 2..3 m land needs 50 m.

properties.name: narrows_cut
properties.why: 25 m across the Verrazzano Narrows (v1.5 verbatim).

properties.name: arthur_kill_cut
properties.why: 25 m across the Arthur Kill mouth (v1.5 verbatim).

properties.name: cape_may_canal
properties.why: 25 m along the Cape May Canal + its Delaware Bay mouth (NOAA 8536110 on the forced wedge). ~100 m wide: at 50 m it is 2 cells.

properties.name: surf_dune_00
properties.why: 25 m surf zone / foredune / barrier: 2.5 km buffer of ONE shoreline segment, clipped to the ring. Split per segment so each polygon's bbox is small - the first probe (one ring-wide L3 polygon) hit 158 GB RSS and was killed, 2026-08-24.
